name: Mystic Reels
review:
A crystal stone-circle game on 20 lines, made with Bulletproof Games. It uses Cascade+, and wilds both complete lines and power up the bonus multipliers.

Free spins bring big multipliers, and an Encore mode leads into respins. The weird part: it's rated medium volatility but lists a max of 45,587x – a huge ceiling for a steady game. 96% RTP, free spins about once every 139 spins. Interesting mix.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 139 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
